trends.whatProductOffers: Pays a lump sum for four common cancers (lung, colon and rectum, breast in females, prostate in males at TNM T1c or above) plus carcinoma-in-situ of breast, colon and rectum and lung, and early stage prostate malignancy at T1a or T1b.

keyFigures.label: Second claim
keyFigures.condition: specific cancer or death before age 80

exclusionsOrConditions: Only the four named cancer sites are covered; other cancers are not.
Prostate cancer must be TNM classification T1c or above for the cancer benefit; T1a or T1b is treated as early stage malignancy at 20%.
Advance payments reduce the Current Sum Assured and the premium accordingly.
The policy terminates once 100% of the Initial Sum Assured has been paid.
Waiting periods and the full covered-illness schedule are not in the extracted text.

sourceEvidence: This plan covers specific cancer protection for 4 common cancers, including lung, colon and rectum, breast and prostate cancer. Should the misfortune occur, we will provide you with a one-off payment

Once the insured is firstly diagnosed with specific Carcinoma-in-situ or Early Stage Malignancy, 20% of the Initial Sum Assured will be payable ... The benefit payment of specific Cancer or death benefit will be reduced from 100% to 80% of the Initial Sum Assured accordingly.

trends.whatProductOffers: Pays a death benefit equal to the Current Sum Assured to the nominated beneficiary if the insured dies before age 80.

keyFigures.label: Current Sum Assured
keyFigures.value: Initial Sum Assured less advance payments

exclusionsOrConditions: The death benefit is reduced by any advance payments already made for carcinoma-in-situ, early stage malignancy or cancer.
This is not a savings or investment plan; there is no cash value stated.
clientProfileFit: Clients wanting cancer cover with a death benefit attached
trends.talkingPointTemplate: Beyond cancer, {client_detail} also leaves the current sum assured to the family if death occurs before age 80.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the death benefit calculation after any advance payments.
sourceEvidence: If the insured ... passes away, we will pay the death benefit to the person whom you select in your policy as beneficiary. The death benefit will be equal to the Current Sum Assured.
trends.notesForReviewer: No separate life sum assured; death benefit is the remaining cancer sum assured.
